paper.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
paper.central_claim: 提出闭环“AI-for-AI”框架开发移动端 Planner Agent：AI 辅助任务构造/失败诊断→数据飞轮、课程式能力自适应 RL(CARE)、模型–Harness（Skills+Memory+反馈）共进化；Qwen-Planner-Agent 27B 在 MobilePA-Bench 上 Overall 77.05%，居所评估模型之首且输出成本较低。

provenance.independence_note: Aggregation over two seat inputs; each fixed paper text was read before the seat scores, but this is not a third blind review or human gold. All results are author reports; nothing was reproduced.

evidence.quote: The agent primarily acts through structured tools rather than pixel-coordinate GUI actions
evidence.support_explanation: The action space is typed tool calls, memory/skill operations and clarification; no GUI operation surface.

evidence.quote: Qwen-Planner-Agent focuses on this planning problem rather than introducing a new screen-grounding architecture.
evidence.support_explanation: Authors place the contribution outside screen perception/grounding.

evidence.quote: Programmatic sandbox environments execute typed tool calls through predefined program logic over structured application databases.
evidence.support_explanation: Main training/evaluation substrate is tool-call sandboxes; MobilePA-Bench verifies via tool calls/state changes.

status_reason: Confirmed out_of_scope. Qwen-Planner-Agent is a mobile planner over typed tool calls, memory and skills; the agent 'primarily acts through structured tools rather than pixel-coordinate GUI actions', the authors state they do not introduce screen grounding, and the headline benchmark (MobilePA-Bench) verifies tool calls/state changes. Optional visual tool returns and opaque sub-agent sessions do not give the evaluated system a GUI operation surface. Under docs/EVIDENCE.md this is a pure API/function-calling agent, excluded from the GUI Agents radar. The exclusion is a scope disposition, not a quality judgement; CARE/harness contributions may belong to a tool-agent project.
aggregate_session_note: Configured model type fable (upstream claude-opus-5-5[1m]) per batch manifest model_types.opus55; no session id or invocation receipt is exposed to this agent.
